g.text: Averaging and overlap: additional storage budget

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #172033

g.text: Planning calculation only · 30 mics · 8 bins · N=512 · 34-bit Fourier state

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: Assumes one bank per concurrent overlapping window and one running map sum. 4.25 GE per stored bit.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: Access logic, extra arithmetic and scheduling are excluded; this is a lower bound for these named arrays only.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: A different scheduling/averaging architecture could require different storage. No multiwindow design is qualified here.
